name: PopHIVE
description: PopHIVE provides harmonized US public health surveillance data from the Yale School of Public Health. Ask about respiratory disease activity (RSV, flu, COVID, measles), chronic disease prevalence (diabetes, obesity), injury trends (overdose, firearm, heat illness), and childhood vaccination coverage across US states and counties. Signals are synthesized from CDC systems, Epic Cosmos, wastewater monitoring, Google Health Trends, and more. Every level, trend, rank, and correlation is computed server-side with full provenance, caveats, and a deep link to the matching pophive.org chart. All data is public, aggregate, and de-identified.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PopHIVE to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PopHIVE to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pophive.org/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is PopHIVE MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, PopHIVE scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PopHIVE MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PopHIVE provides these MCP tools: get_overview, get_current_status, get_trend, get_map, compare, get_coverage, and get_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PopHIVE?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PopHIVE in health on the Manufact MCP catalog include CMS Coverage, NPI Registry, AllTrails MCP Server, ICD-10 Codes, and Alma.
PopHIVE does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
PopHIVE is developed by Yale School of Public Health. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
